title: Helcim, a payments processor for SMBs, raised a CA$53M Series C led by Business Development Bank of Canada's Growth Venture Fund at a CA$250M valuation (Madison McLauchlan/BetaKit)
summary: Madison McLauchlan / BetaKit: Helcim, a payments processor for SMBs, raised a CA$53M Series C led by Business Development Bank of Canada's Growth Venture Fund at a CA$250M valuation — Calgary company reaches $250-million valuation, hopes to grow after Moneris sells to US private equity.
